sourceGaps: The official question and official marking scheme are reproduced with their printed inconsistencies retained. Instruction 3 on question page 2 has no text. The installation heading says “26 mm disk”; the apparatus table and later tasks say 26 cm. The marking scheme uses 20 mm/26 mm in A.1 and 20 mm in G.1. Table 1 labels current in A but prints mA entries. B.2 is labelled 0.8 points although its itemised marks total 0.7; B.3 asks for an exponential trendline in its marking criteria but displays a linear one. B.6(ii) uses 65 g instead of the 89 g specified for the requested 3 mm disk. B.6(iv) uses a 25 cm arm instead of the procedure's 15 cm, and prints rad⁻¹s⁻¹. Its geometry also prints L=L sin φ without distinguishing the two quantities. D.3 marks “faster” although its sample graph decreases with disk thickness. D.4 defines R as radius but substitutes 0.2 m, and again uses 25 cm. E.2's plotted ordinate is labelled Speed (rpm) although the sample data are in rad/s. Part F is headed 1.5 points in the question and 2.1 in the key; its printed questions sum to 1.5. The key's reduced Euler equations use minus signs where the question's equations use plus signs. No values or marking points have been silently replaced. The archive TXT companion only points to a Russian solution at https://pho.rs/p/4072/m; it is an archive pointer, not a second supplied solution text. That remote text was not available in this source packet.
